description.value: Villa Rosa Ristorante is one of Penticton's most established Italian restaurants, open at the same Westminster Avenue location since 1996 and under current owners Tyler and Nicole Gable since 2007. The grapevine-covered patio with twinkle lights was recognized by OpenTable among Canada's 100 best for outdoor dining, and the kitchen leans heavily on fresh local Okanagan produce. Voted best Italian in the South Okanagan, it is a well-regarded dinner stop in the heart of Penticton's cycling corridor.
